data.name: Usage
data.value: Usage: date [-u] [-I|-R] [+FORMAT] Print the current date and time in the time zone of the process (its TZ, else Settings > Date and time). -u, --utc print Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) -I, --iso-8601 print the date in ISO 8601 format (2026-10-29) -R, --rfc-email print the date and time in RFC 5322 format +FORMAT %Y %m %d %e %H %M %S %Z %z %a %b %A %B %j %s %F %T %D %R %%

data.name: CannotSet
data.value: date: cannot set the date '{0}': the clock of HackerOS is the simulation clock
